name: Social Running Clubs
description: Run clubs have shifted from training groups to social infrastructure — people join to meet people, and the run is the excuse. City-level clubs are spawning weekly, with post-run coffee as the actual product.
why_now: Club formation and 'join a run club' intent are both climbing fast and have not peaked. Content in this space is community-led, so credibility beats production value — brands can enter without feeling like an ad.

citations.title: Run clubs are the new dating app
citations.snippet: Attendance at urban run clubs has roughly tripled year on year, with organisers reporting that social motivation now outranks fitness goals.

citations.title: The rise of the social run club
citations.snippet: New club registrations are up sharply, concentrated in the 18-30 bracket and skewing female for the first time.

citations.title: Why brands are showing up at run clubs
citations.snippet: Athletic brands are moving budget from stadium sponsorship toward neighbourhood run club partnerships.

name: Strava Wrapped
description: The annual year-in-review recap moment, where athletes share their yearly mileage cards across social. Enormous spike, extremely short tail.
why_now: This one has already peaked. The recap cycle has passed its sharing window and conversation is decaying quickly — the engine flags it as a trap rather than an opportunity.

citations.title: Strava's Year in Sport lands
citations.snippet: The annual recap drove a record single-day sharing spike before returning to baseline within two weeks.

citations.title: Why recap marketing has a two-week shelf life
citations.snippet: Recap formats concentrate nearly all engagement into a 10-day window, making late entry effectively worthless.

name: Hybrid Training
description: Runners lifting and lifters running. The single-discipline identity is dissolving in favour of combined strength-and-endurance programming.
why_now: Steady, non-seasonal climb with a long runway and no peak in sight yet.

citations.title: The hybrid athlete takes over
citations.snippet: Combined strength-endurance programming is the fastest growing category in coaching apps.

citations.title: Runners are finally lifting
citations.snippet: Search interest in strength work for runners has doubled, led by women under 30.

name: Zone 2 Everything
description: Low-intensity aerobic training as a lifestyle identity, spilling out of endurance sport into general wellness.
why_now: Very high momentum but essentially at peak — the window to act is nearly closed.

citations.title: Zone 2 is everywhere
citations.snippet: The low-intensity training concept has crossed from endurance sport into mainstream wellness advice.

name: Marathon Debut Culture
description: First-time marathon documentation as a content genre — the training block as a serialised story, not a single race-day post.
why_now: Strong sustained climb tied to the autumn race calendar, with a long tail.

citations.title: Everyone is running their first marathon
citations.snippet: Debut marathon entries from women under 30 have risen sharply for a third consecutive year.

citations.title: The marathon training vlog boom
citations.snippet: Serialised training-block content is outperforming race-day recaps on watch time.

name: Run-Commuting
description: Replacing the commute with a run, and the gear problem that creates.
why_now: Early but real — low current momentum with a long runway, worth watching.

citations.title: The run commute is having a moment
citations.snippet: Run-commuting mentions are climbing steadily in major metros with improving cycling infrastructure.

name: Track Club Fashion
description: Retro track-club aesthetics moving from sport into everyday wardrobes.
why_now: Mid-climb style trend with meaningful crossover into apparel purchase intent.

citations.title: Track club is the new prep
citations.snippet: Retro club kit has become a dominant reference across streetwear and athleisure collections.

name: Silent Walking
description: Walking without headphones as a mindfulness practice.
why_now: Already collapsed. Included to show the engine rejecting a dead trend.

citations.title: Silent walking, explained
citations.snippet: The practice spiked on social video before fading almost as quickly as it arrived.
